from brackets import is_balanced, is_bracket

true_cases = ['', '()', '[]', '{}', '()[]{}', '([{}])', '(a[b]{c})', 'f(x[0], y[1])', '((()))', '[[]]', '{{}}', '([]){}[()]', 'abc', ' \t\n', '你好（）', "'\\([{}])'\n"]
false_cases = ['(', ')', '([)]', '(]', '{[}', '())', '[', '{', '(()', '([]', ']', '}', ')(', '][', '}{']
for value in true_cases:
    result = is_balanced(value)
    assert result is True and type(result) is bool, (value, result)
for value in false_cases:
    result = is_balanced(value)
    assert result is False and type(result) is bool, (value, result)
for value in [None, True, 0, 1.5, b'()', [], (), {}, iter(['(', ')'])]:
    try:
        is_balanced(value)
    except TypeError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError(value)
class Text(str):
    pass
assert is_balanced(Text('([{}])')) is True
assert is_balanced(Text('([)]')) is False
assert [is_balanced(s) for s in ['(', '()', ')', '']] == [False, True, False, True]
assert all(is_bracket(c) is True for c in '()[]{}')
assert all(is_bracket(c) is False for c in ['a', '', '((', 1])
print('contract checks passed')
